verdict.rationale: PostHog docs explicitly state you can save insights to dashboards, share them, and get alerted when the numbers move abnormally (posthog-docs-3, posthog-docs-25), plus alert routing to Slack/PagerDuty/monitoring tools (posthog-intdir-2). This directly matches the PM story of subscribing to dashboard alerts. missing for 10: no documentation of subscription mechanics (e.g., email digest cadence, per-user subscription vs org-wide alert), no independent/hands-on confirmation of alert accuracy or anomaly-detection sophistication.
